items.statement: For every actual Gaussian mu and globally L-Lipschitz scalar f on the stated Banach/Borel space, f is Bochner integrable and exp(t*(f-int f dmu)) is integrable for every real t. This is a Gaussian-domain background theorem, not the sharp concentration bound.
assumptions: Real complete second-countable normed vector space E with Borel measurable structure, Gaussian probability measure mu (possibly noncentered/degenerate).

Actual globally Lipschitz scalar function f:E->R with NNReal constant L, including L=0. No differentiability, boundedness, positive dimension, given mean, Laplace certificate or sharp coefficient premise.

formulae.label: Gaussian Lipschitz first moment and signed exponential domain
formulae.tex: f\in L^1(\mu),\qquad e^{t(f-\int f\,d\mu)}\in L^1(\mu)\quad(t\in\mathbb R).
